description: This file defines a React component for an 'Add Reminder' dialog in the Notesnook application, including UI elements for setting reminder details such as date, time, recurrence, priority, and description. It also registers the dialog with a dialog manager and provides an 'Edit Reminder' helper.

classes.name: AddReminderDialog
classes.description: A React component registered as a dialog for adding or editing reminders, with internal state management for reminder properties.

methods.name: timeFormat
methods.description: Returns the current time format string based on user settings.

methods.name: getSelectedDaysText
methods.description: Generates a human-readable string for selected days based on recurrence mode and week day labels.

methods.name: nth
methods.description: Returns the ordinal suffix ('st', 'nd', 'rd', 'th') for a given number.

methods.name: LabeledSelect
methods.description: A React component for a labeled select dropdown used for month and day selection in yearly recurrence mode.
